description: The selected model keeps the keyboard focus once the panel settles. The screen is 1280x800. The page runs on a fake clock that steps advance with eval "window.__clock.runFor(ms)". To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". 1. Navigate to /new and open the model picker. 2. The panel's searchbox (role "searchbox") should be document.activeElement. 3. Run the clock for 1000ms. 4. There should be exactly one ".p-select-option.p-focus" in the panel, and it must have the class "p-select-option-selected".
